title: India, 1995
tagline: The internet for the public and the year's highest-grossing film.

locale.persona: an urban household in India (typical, not one named family)
locale.placeNameNote: Period place names with today's name in brackets on first mention, e.g. Bombay (now Mumbai).

morningRoutine.detail: Internet access, limited to educational and research users since 1986, opened to the general public on 15 August 1995 through the state telecom company VSNL.
Aditya Chopra's romance, released on 20 October 1995, was the year's highest-grossing Hindi film.
A. R. Rahman composed the music for Bombay, released in March 1995.
The illustrated-story series, founded by Anant Pai in 1967, was still the best-known source of comic-book myth and history.
